texts.zh: [Root.GetName]本地的政府失误导致一小群叛军收获了更多支持者，他们反对我们的传统思潮。支持他们的人越来越多，这让他们在该区域获得了更大的权利。这样的支持同时也让他们在获得民众支持上取得了一定成功，他们可以利用这些支持来发展自己的事业。
texts.en: Local political drama on [Root.GetName] has resulted in increased support among a small group of rebels, opposed to our underlying ethics. Their increased support have enabled them to gain more power in the region and vote for their own causes with limited success.

texts.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]扎根落地，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的道路。虽然这是意料之中的事，但他们已经拥有了不少的支持者。该群体认为，我们对宇宙唯心主义的世界观无法快速引领我们前进，而他们坚信更加唯物主义的宇宙观才是答案。
texts.en: As we have grown our roots on [Root.GetName] certain individuals have begun to stray from our beaten path. That is to be expected, but these have supporters. The group feels our spiritualistic view of the universe is not leading us forward fast enough - assured that a more materialistic view of the cosmos is the answer.

texts.en: As we have grown our roots on [Root.GetName] certain individuals have begun to stray from our beaten path. That is to be expected, but these have supporters. The group feels our spiritualistic view of the universe is not leading us forward fast enough - assured that a more materialistic view of the cosmos is the answer.

texts.zh: 随着我们在[Root.GetName]上的扩张逐步稳定，某些居民开始偏离我们原本的世界观。一群唯心主义者开始和平地传播思想以反对我们的政府。他们认为我们对宇宙唯物主义的观点正令我们作茧自缚，并让我们与灵魂渐行渐远。
texts.en: As our expansion on [Root.GetName] has stabilized, certain individuals have begun to move away from our view of the world. A group of spiritualists has begun to peacefully propagate against our government. They see that our materialistic view of the cosmos is limiting us and distancing us from the soul.

texts.en: As our expansion on [Root.GetName] has stabilized, certain individuals have begun to move away from our view of the world. A group of spiritualists has begun to peacefully propagate against our government. They see that our materialistic view of the cosmos is limiting us and distancing us from the soul.

label.zh: 他们不会对我们构成威胁。
label.en: They are no threat to our pursuits.
Leave them be to find their own way.

label.zh: 让精神向导帮他们改邪归正。
展开大规模的反制公告。

texts.zh: 多亏了我们的精神领袖的不懈努力，我们终于力挽狂澜，吸引来了越来越多的无信仰人士。这些人不限于唯物主义者，甚至乎包括了其他宗教人士。愿他们从此不再误入歧途。
texts.en: Thanks to the tireless efforts of our spiritual leaders we have finally turned the tide, and are bringing more and more faithless into the fold. Not only materialists, but people of all persuasions have seen the light and are casting away their former beliefs. Pray they will never stray from the righteous path again.

texts.zh: 多亏了我们的精神领袖的不懈努力，我们终于力挽狂澜，吸引来了越来越多的无信仰人士。这些人不限于唯物主义者，甚至乎包括了其他宗教人士。愿他们从此不再误入歧途。
texts.en: Thanks to the tireless efforts of our spiritual leaders we have finally turned the tide, and are bringing more and more faithless into the fold. Not only materialists, but people of all persuasions have seen the light and are casting away their former beliefs. Pray they will never stray from the righteous path again.

texts.zh: 成功对部分试图反对我们主要思潮的人口进行了重新教导。 我们的宣传机器和计划中一样的运行。不仅仅是唯心主义者，那些骑墙派也明白了理性的可贵，并且为了支持唯物主义抛弃了他们从前的妄想。
texts.en: Our attempts at re-directing the parts of the population prone to oppose our core ideals have finally paid off. Our propaganda machine has worked as promised. Not only spiritualists, but people of all persuasions are seeing reason and casting aside their former delusions in favor of materialism.

texts.en: Our attempts at re-directing the parts of the population prone to oppose our core ideals have finally paid off. Our propaganda machine has worked as promised. Not only spiritualists, but people of all persuasions are seeing reason and casting aside their former delusions in favor of materialism.

texts.zh: 我们做出改变[Root.GetName]上人口思想的尝试简直就是搬起石头砸自己的脚。通过团结起来反抗我们的文化镇压，他们获得了更多的追随者，这使他们变得比以前还要强大。
texts.en: Our attempts to change the minds of our people on [Root.GetName] have backfired horribly. By banding together over our subjugation attempts they have gained even more followers, making them stronger than ever.
